notes.title: Outrunner: Neon Nights is available!
notes.content:
I am so happy to share these news with you!

For everyone who played the NextFest Demo, here is what changed since then:
- Boost is now always available, instead of being a powerup
- Added a new Break powerup
- Added a capture the flag mode
- Added custom game modes
- Added shared keyboard splitscreen in addition to keyboard + gamepad
- Added achievements
- Lots of quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes

And of course, the full game now contains all maps and predefined modes. Furthermore, you can play a custom mode where you can modify a lot of stuff. Go crazy! You can play with up to 6 players with public matchmaking, up to 8 in a party or local-split screen with a friend.

I updated the Demo to the latest version, just with a limited set of modes and maps!

If you have any questions, feedback, or find any bugs, please let me know here in the community.

Have fun!
Georg

notes.title: Next Fest Demo is Live NOW
notes.content:
Next Fest
Outrunner: Neon Nights has been in the works for a long time. I am so happy to tell you, that you can try the Demo from now on!

What you get
You can enjoy the beautiful atmosphere with dangerous PvP battles.
Play with public matchmaking, a private game with friends, or a local split-screen game.
You will have access to 3 of the maps: City, Tower and Arena.
You will be able to play 2 of the game modes: Deathmatch and a arcade-style with 90° turns

Matchmaking
Kickstarting a multiplayer game as a solo dev is hard. If you have trouble finding others to play with, consider joining the discord. Plan sessions with strangers, and make new friends :)
Check it out here: https://discord.gg/XywbkjMEd6


I hope you'll have a good time
Georg
